title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 6 October 2026
description: Tech leaders sign a voluntary AI safety accord as the FTC investigates major AI labs, plus OpenAI's DevDay announcements, a new wildlife sanctuary on King Island and the closure of the Jerilderie saleyard, Queensland's severe cyclone season outlook and rising public sector data breaches, and the Gold Coast Suns' looming decision on AFL free agent Ben King. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
